tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List public ClinicMarketIQ dataset families from the canonical catalog. Returns metadata summaries, not observation rows.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search public dataset family IDs, names, slugs, and publishers in the canonical ClinicMarketIQ catalog.

tools.name: get_dataset_metadata
tools.description: Fetch the canonical public machine index for one ClinicMarketIQ dataset family, including provenance-facing download metadata and immutable manifest pointer.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Fetch schema JSON declared by a dataset's immutable public manifest. If schema_name is omitted, returns all declared schemas (currently capped at 10).

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Return canonical direct download URLs and declared SHA-256 values for a public dataset. This tool never proxies the dataset bytes.

tools.name: verify_checksum
tools.description: Compare a caller-provided SHA-256 digest with the canonical digest declared in the public dataset machine index. This bounded check does not download or re-hash large artifact bytes.
